data.title: Bußgeldbescheid – traffic fine of €182 for prohibited overtaking
data.summary: The Zentraldienst der Polizei Muster-Brandenburg (Brandenburg police central fines office) issued a Bußgeldbescheid against Ronny Musterspree for overtaking a truck despite a no-overtaking sign near Beispielkow on 2 October 2026. The notice sets a fine of €150 plus a €28.50 fee and €3.50 delivery costs (total €182.00) and records 1 point in the driving register (Fahreignungsregister).
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) from the Brandenburg police fines office for a traffic offence on 2 October 2026 (overtaking despite a ban). It sets a total of €182.00 (fine, fee and delivery costs) and adds 1 point to your driving record. You may file an objection (Einspruch) against the notice, in writing or on record, with the fines office; the app shows the deadline for this based on the actual delivery date shown on the returned delivery certificate. If you do not object by the deadline shown, the fine becomes final and the total amount must then be paid within two weeks of that. Consider legal advice if you are unsure whether to object.
